experiment.title: Is the news new or already known? FNSPID development test
experiment.selected_rq: Does negative-news share add predictive information for next-session abnormal returns beyond mean continuous sentiment and news volume, and is that increment stable?
experiment.rq_link: Input-side precondition for the selected RQ: the frozen aggregates are computed over every story on a firm-day, including near-verbatim restatements of what the same firm already published. This experiment asks whether the information sits in the new stories and not in the already-known ones.
experiment.evidence_role: retrospective development-only measurement and conditioning evidence
experiment.evaluation_block_rule: session_date >= 2020-01-01 is not loaded, ranked, or scored in this notebook. Notebook 75 already opened that block once for the selected RQ and is not re-opened or re-run here.

fnspid_story_novelty.provenance: Notebook 02 repetition screen: 30-day trailing same-firm window, strictly earlier sessions only, headline text already dropped

fnspid_firm_day_aggregators.role: outcome ar_open_h1, split label, and the published all-story aggregates used for reconciliation

fnspid_finbert_checkpoint.role: per-story pinned-FinBERT scores and class probabilities joined to the novelty screen on event_key; headline text is never read

novelty_definition.already_known: exact normalized-headline repeat against a strictly earlier same-firm session in the trailing 30-day window, OR best trailing-window token Jaccard overlap at or above the operative threshold
novelty_definition.new: every other story; the screen cannot distinguish genuinely new information from an unrecognised paraphrase, so this leg is new-or-unclassified
novelty_definition.threshold_choice_disclosure: Chosen return-blind from a story- and firm-day-count screen run before any outcome was loaded. At 0.80 only 3.4% of development firm-days are mixed, which cannot identify a within-session contrast; at 0.30 the screen begins absorbing generic boilerplate overlap. 0.50 yields 82,027 development firm-days with at least one already-known story and 53,367 mixed days.
novelty_definition.calibration_status: uncalibrated — the blinded 180-story human audit from Notebook 02 has no labels, so precision and recall of the screen are unknown
novelty_definition.market_recap_flag: retained as a separate descriptive field; not treated as repetition

population.outcome: ar_open_h1, stock-minus-SPY adjusted-open return from formation session t to t+1
population.mixed_day_restriction: The two primary contrasts are identified only on firm-days holding at least one story of each kind, because both legs must be defined. This conditions on a variable correlated with news volume; the story-count distribution of mixed versus all days is reported as a caveat, not corrected for.

estimand.unit: daily cross-sectional rank-regression coefficient followed by a time-series mean
estimand.outcome_transform: within-session average-tie percentile rank of ar_open_h1, centred at zero
estimand.regressor_transform: within-session average-tie centred percentile rank of each regressor
estimand.inference: OLS intercept on the daily coefficient or contrast series with Newey-West HAC lag 5; two-sided 95 percent interval
estimand.secondary_inference: 20-session circular block bootstrap of the same mean, 9,999 replications, seed 20260814
estimand.excluded_sessions: sessions below the minimum name count, with a constant ranked variable, or with a rank-deficient design are dropped and counted

primary_family.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the three tests below at q = 0.05

tests.name: mean sentiment: new minus already known
tests.sample: mixed development firm-days at the primary threshold
tests.model: rank(ar_open_h1) ~ rank(mean_new) + rank(mean_known) + rank(negshare_new) + rank(negshare_known) + rank(log1p(n))
tests.expected_direction: positive if the market prices new sentiment and has already priced the restated stories

tests.name: negative-story share: new minus already known
tests.sample: mixed development firm-days at the primary threshold
tests.expected_direction: negative, matching the frozen development sign of the all-story negative-share coefficient

tests.name: already-known share beyond the frozen regressors
tests.sample: all development firm-days at the primary threshold

success_rule: A test counts as supporting novelty conditioning only if its BH-adjusted two-sided p-value is at or below 0.05 AND, for T1 and T2, the point estimate carries the declared sign. Zero survivors is the recorded result, not a prompt to search further specifications.
secondary_reported_not_in_family: the same three tests replayed at Jaccard 0.40, 0.60 and 0.80
the two marginal three-regressor models (mean legs only; negative-share legs only)
descriptive measurement: already-known share by year, by story-count bin, and against the market-recap flag
descriptive cross-firm syndication rate: normalized headline hashes appearing for more than one symbol on the same session
stopping_rule: One execution of the declared family. No threshold, control, stratum, or model added after any primary coefficient is visible. Any post-result analysis is labelled post-hoc and excluded from the family.
licence_boundary: Headline text is never loaded. All artifacts are written to the gitignored final_experiments/outputs/85_fnspid_novelty_conditioned_information/ directory and contain aggregate rows only.
